DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC)

The lab results show a pattern of cholestasis with significantly elevated Alkaline Phosphatase and Bilirubin, but your normal hemoglobin rules out the hemolysis suggested by your initial symptoms. I need to check your medical history for any skin rashes or dry eyes, which are common in this condition.
